# Thinking Raven brand

> Official brand kit for Thinking Raven (thinkingraven.com): logos, colours, typography, ready-made exports and usage rules. AI agents should follow AGENTS.md and use only these files. Never redraw or retype the logo.

Key facts: the name in prose is "Thinking Raven". The logo is the lowercase wordmark "thinkingraven." with an amber full stop. Colours: ink #0F0F14, bone #F3EFE6, amber #F2A93B (accent only; never text on light backgrounds). Font: Space Grotesk. Mascot: Thinky. Contact: hello@thinkingraven.com.

## Rules
- [AGENTS.md](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/AGENTS.md): full instructions for agents (which file to use where, rules, voice, snippets)
- [Brand guidelines site](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/): human-readable guide

## Tokens
- [tokens.json](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/tokens/tokens.json): colour, type and radius tokens
- [tokens.css](https://thinkingraven.github.io/brand/tokens/tokens.css): CSS variables plus the @font-face
